item.title: 📐 Profession of special importance: the legendary Military Technical University is back in St. Petersburg
item.description: 📐 Profession of special importance: the legendary Military Technical University is back in St. Petersburg 🤝 On Knowledge Day, the Deputy Russian Minister of Defence Pavel Fradkov inspected the readiness of the re-established Military Engineering-Technical University and congratulated its cadets. 💬 Pavel Fradkov stressed that great prospects for service to the benefit of the Fatherland lay ahead of them, and their professionalism would directly strengthen the country's defence capabilities. More than 400 people entered the university in 2026. The cadets will undergo training at 21 modern training complexes. ▫️ Godspeed, future engineers! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Mastering Science of Victory. Keep going! Taking advantage of the innovations and experience of the special military operation to the maximum!

Andrei Belousov inspected the readiness of the Moscow Guards Higher Combined Arms Command School for the start of the new academic year. He examined the classrooms and checked the accommodation and recreation conditions of cadets.
📊
This year, more than 800 cadets have been enrolled in the first year, more than 100 of whom are participants of the special military operation.

the experience of combat operations during the military training is maximally implemented in the educational process.
🎮
The school provides training in promising military specializations, including ‘the use of Ground Forces units with unmanned aerial vehicles’. The training is conducted by experienced instructors, 90 per cent of whom took part in the special military operation.

One of them is the Hameleon-BPS. It allows to train future commanders to assess the situation and analyze intelligence data, make decisions and perform them in a single virtual platform. There are also 3D maps of the terrain, several types of UAVs, It also uses 3D maps of the area, several types of UAVs, including ground-based robotic systems.
➡️
Since September 1,
the training of cadets began at the pilot training cluster deployed at the school
with a system of information interaction and situational awareness of officials in the tactical management unit
"SVOD"
.

The legendary Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School rightfully gets the Guards status!
Minister of Defence Andrei Belousov attached Ribbon of Saint George to the banner of Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School. Since now, Russian legendary Higher School has officially turned into the Guards Higher School.
💬
Addressing to cadets, teachers, and veterans of the school,
Andrei Belousov noted that this title is
not just a status, but
more than a century of living history, heroism, courage and loyalty of thousands of his graduates, whom our country is proud of.
👉
The head of the Ministry of Defence congratulated the cadets and recalled that
‘the Guards status is not only a great honour, but also a serious responsibility’
📆
Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School is rightfully called legendary. Its history is full of heroic pages.
At the beginning of October 1941, the cadets regiment took part in the fiercest battle for Moscow in Volokolamsk direction. For the heroism and courage shown in those battles, 59 cadets and 30 officers were awarded orders and medals. To conmemorate heroes, a memorial board was opened on the main building of the School.
📊
Over the entire history of the school, five Marshals and over 600 Generals studied here. Nearly 150 graduates awarded the title of Hero of the Soviet Union and the Russian Federation. The school itself was awarded four times with government awards.

Andrei Belousov
laid flowers at the monument to the "Kremlin Graduates"
and paid tribute to the memory of the servicemen who gave their lives during the military duty performance.
▫️
Today, the Moscow Guards Higher Combined Arms Command School
is one of the country's leading military educational institutions, that has a glorious history and glorious future.

item.title: 📌 Main efforts must be focused on learning combat experience! Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Valery Solodchuk congratulated cadets of the Mili
item.description: 📌 Main efforts must be focused on learning combat experience! Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Valery Solodchuk congratulated cadets of the Military Academy of Logistical Support named after General of the Army A.V. Khrulyov on the start of new academic year. Main efforts must be focused on learning combat experience, methods of conducting combat operations, analysing data of the use of new weapons and special military hardware,' noted the Deputy Minister of Defence. 📊 In 2026, more than 2,500 cadets entered the Military Academy of Logistical Support and its branches. It wasn't easy to choose the best ones: the competition grew by 10%, and in total about 6,000 people fought for the right to study here. Among those who managed to enter the Academy there are children of veterans and the participants of the special military operation. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29146

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
They hit manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades near Ulanovo, Korenek, Malaya Rybitsa, and Streletskaya Pushkarka (Sumy region).
💥
In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one border detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine near the settlements of Sosnovy Bor, Berezhnoye, Podsredneye, Rublenoye, and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
▫️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 11 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade close to Lesnaya Stenka, Grushevka (Kharkov region), Svyatogorsk, Sidorovo, and Shchurovo (Donetsk People's Republic).
▫️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 180 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 19 motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, including one Polish-made Krab self-propelled artillery system, and one U.S.-made AN/TPQ-50 counter-fire station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
The Russian troops hit formations of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade, two unmanned systems brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and territorial defence brigade near Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Vasyutinskoye, Druzhkovka, Kurtovka, and Raiskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▫️
The enemy has lost more than 210 troops, three Western-made armoured fighting vehicles, 25 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Strikes were inflicted on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Raksha, Novofedorovka, and Novotroitskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▫️
More than 365 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, and three field artillery guns were neutralised.
👉

🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
